#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {}
    
    class Reader {
    private:
        istream& in;
    public:
        Reader(istream& i) : in(i) {}
        
        string next() {
            string token;
            in >> token;
            return token;
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            int val;
            in >> val;
            return val;
        }
    };
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> adjList;
    int nodeCount, edgeCount;
    vector<int> pi, d, prevEdgeIdx;
    vector<int> u, v, uv, cost;
    vector<int> cap;
    
    void setup(int n, int m) {
        adjList.assign(n, vector<int>());
        pi.assign(n, INF);
        d.assign(n, INF);
        prevEdgeIdx.assign(n, 0);
        u.assign(m, 0);
        v.assign(m, 0);
        uv.assign(m, 0);
        cost.assign(m, 0);
        cap.assign(m * 2, 0);
        edgeCount = 0;
    }
    
    void connect(int a, int b, int capacity, int c) {
        int idx = edgeCount++;
        u[idx] = a;
        v[idx] = b;
        uv[idx] = a ^ b;
        cost[idx] = c;
        cap[idx * 2] = capacity;
        adjList[a].push_back(idx * 2);
        adjList[b].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> queueArr;
    int qStart, qLen, qCap;
    vector<bool> inQ;
    
    void push(int node) {
        if (inQ[node]) return;
        if (qStart + qLen == (int)queueArr.size()) {
            if (qLen * 2 <= (int)queueArr.size()) {
                vector<int> newQueue(queueArr.begin() + qStart, queueArr.begin() + qStart + qLen);
                queueArr = newQueue;
                qStart = 0;
            } else {
                vector<int> tmp(queueArr.size() * 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < qLen; i++) {
                    tmp[i] = queueArr[qStart + i];
                }
                queueArr = tmp;
                qStart = 0;
            }
        }
        queueArr[qStart + qLen++] = node;
        inQ[node] = true;
    }
    
    int pop() {
        int node = queueArr[qStart++];
        qLen--;
        inQ[node] = false;
        return node;
    }
    
    bool bellmanFord(int src, int dst) {
        fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[src] = 0;
        qStart = qLen = 0;
        push(src);
        
        while (qLen > 0) {
            int x = pop();
            int nd = d[x] + 1;
            
            for (int e : adjList[x]) {
                if (cap[e] > 0) {
                    int idx = e >> 1;
                    int c = (e & 1) == 0 ? cost[idx] : -cost[idx];
                    int np = pi[x] + c;
                    int y = x ^ uv[idx];
                    
                    if (pi[y] > np || (pi[y] == np && d[y] > nd)) {
                        pi[y] = np;
                        d[y] = nd;
                        prevEdgeIdx[y] = e;
                        push(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pi[dst] != INF;
    }
    
    void augment(int s, int t) {
        int minCap = INF;
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= uv[prevEdgeIdx[cur] >> 1]) {
            minCap = min(minCap, cap[prevEdgeIdx[cur]]);
        }
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= uv[prevEdgeIdx[cur] >> 1]) {
            int idx = prevEdgeIdx[cur];
            cap[idx] -= minCap;
            cap[idx ^ 1] += minCap;
        }
    }
    
    void augmentUnit(int s, int t) {
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= uv[prevEdgeIdx[cur] >> 1]) {
            int idx = prevEdgeIdx[cur];
            cap[idx]--;
            cap[idx ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        while (bellmanFord(s, t)) {
            augmentUnit(s, t);
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; i++) {
            total += cost[i] * cap[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void solve() {
        Reader reader(cin);
        int n = reader.nextInt();
        int m = reader.nextInt();
        int k = reader.nextInt();
        int c = reader.nextInt();
        int d_val = reader.nextInt();
        
        vector<int> special(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) special[i] = reader.nextInt() - 1;
        
        vector<vector<int>> g(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i] = vector<int>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = reader.nextInt() - 1;
            int b = reader.nextInt() - 1;
            g[a].push_back(b);
            g[b].push_back(a);
        }
        
        int T = k + 1;
        int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
        int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
        setup(totalNodes, totalEdges);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u_node = i * T + t;
                for (int w : g[i]) {
                    int v_node = w * T + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        connect(u_node, v_node, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d_val);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u_node = i * T + t;
                int v_node = u_node + 1;
                connect(u_node, v_node, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            connect(totalNodes - 1, special[i] * T, 1, 0);
        }
        
        cout << minCostFlow(totalNodes - 1, 0 * T + T - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
